construct: RULED, THE K2 CELL (refreshed 2026-09-21): k2_overview 40–70w (the persona's current in the element's arena) + k2_functional ≤22w (the god's own family function, re-ruled 2026-09-01) + k2_domain_readings 18–55w per ruled domain (owner construct 2026-08-19, corpus ×50 LOCKED) · adj_chips {catalyst ×3, friction ×3} 1–3w under THE KEYWORD DERIVATION CHAIN (2026-09-03) and THE VOCABULARY ZONE B1–B2 (2026-09-04) · fn_reading = the weighted three-door ledger {word, doors:{trait, scene, outside}} ×3 per pole, 35–55w per door (THE THREE DOORS 2026-09-03; corpus ×50 complete 2026-09-04) · structural_interaction = the REA_03 §4b authoring seed · k2_card = the unauthored register stub (REA_03 §4, superseded by the cell above). Prompts: REA_17 §3.4. · edge (catalyst pole only; owner 2026-10-16, THE EDGE v9: two sentences, the energy and its three ruling domains from the GOD table, then a clause per domain in The Pattern's voice; the metric; the head derived in the app)

candidates.structural_interaction: Water setting standard for Fire cross-polarity — depth asking whether warmth is sustainable
candidates.k2_overview: Your Water moves as the Magistrate: navigable law, order that flows. You govern the way good rivers govern valleys, setting course without shouting, adjusting to terrain while staying a river. Your rules bend around cases and still arrive at the sea. It is the subtlest authority, and people obey it thinking they chose to.
candidates.k2_functional: Your order runs like a canal: dug once with care, then carrying everyone’s traffic for decades.

k2_domain_readings.Career: Your career advances by navigation: reading currents, timing passages, arriving at rank without visible strain. Diplomacy, coordination, the harbor-master roles. Your course is quiet and it compounds.
k2_domain_readings.Status: Your standing spreads like watershed reputation: carried by word of mouth into places you have never been. Tend the source. Everything downstream tastes of it.
k2_domain_readings.Order: Your order is current-shaped: rules that adapt to terrain yet keep direction. People experience your governance as ease. Document the channel, or it evaporates when you do.

catalyst.define: As a catalyst, the pull stays faint. You rise by small, steady steps.

angles.drive: You follow through long after the mood that said yes has gone. Following through matters more to you than improving, so you finish the version you announced. People plan around your word because it holds.
angles.cost_self: Following through is the part of yourself you count on. Because stopping halfway feels like a broken promise, you follow through on what no longer fits rather than leave it. Whole seasons go into plans you outgrew long ago.
angles.cost_others: Your follow-through covers everyone attached to the plan. You follow the agreed course through rather than reopen it, and you hold them to a course never rechecked. Those working with you keep to a road that may no longer suit them.

angles.drive: You earn trust slowly and prefer it that way. You care about being counted on more than being liked, so you earn trust by record rather than by charm. The faith people place in you survives a bad year.
angles.cost_self: Slowly earned trust is the only trust you believe. You would rather earn trust over a year than win it in a day, since quick trust feels false. Work that needed you this month goes to someone with an easier smile.
angles.cost_others: Trust from you comes as slowly as you earn it. Since easy trust feels false to you, you make a new person earn it rather than let them in. Newcomers spend a long first year on the outside of your circle.

angles.drive: You pace yourself through things other people sprint. Arriving whole counts for more with you than arriving first, and you keep a pace you can hold for years. You are still going strong long after the quick starters have dropped out.
angles.cost_self: Your pace is set so that nothing breaks. Since a sprint costs the steadiness you built, you keep your pace rather than take the opening that needs a rush. You lose the openings that needed a rush to the pace that keeps you whole.
angles.cost_others: Pacing yourself paces everyone beside you. You would rather arrive together than let one run ahead, and you keep everyone at your pace. Nobody walking with you is ever left behind.

friction.define: As a friction, good standing feels like shelter and the rules weigh more than your wishes. Much goes untried and unspoken.

angles.drive: You hold back your yes until you are sure you will keep it. A promise you might break feels worse to you than none at all, and every offer waits while you check. Good offers run out in the gap.
angles.cost_self: Holding the yes keeps you out of promises you could not keep. You need your word to be solid before it leaves you, and a maybe can sit with you for weeks. Those weeks of maybe tire you more than the promise would.
angles.cost_others: The people who ask you for something wait longer for your yes than for anyone else's. Your yes has to be one you will stand behind, and the question hangs open while you weigh it. Their plans stay on hold until your answer comes.

angles.drive: You wait for permission that is not coming. Being given permission feels safer than taking it, and you wait to be asked up rather than step up unasked. You already hold most of the permission you sit waiting for.
angles.cost_self: Waiting for permission keeps you in line. Since permission given feels cleaner than permission taken, you would rather keep your place than claim the next one. You watch the step above yours go to whoever stopped waiting first.
angles.cost_others: Your waiting for permission gets passed down the line. Since you would rather have permission than have the lead, you hold their answer until yours arrives. Each day you hold out for permission, you spend one of theirs as well.

angles.drive: You bite your tongue long before anyone asks you to. You bite down rather than cost the mood, since a smooth evening feels safer to you than an honest one. You keep the peace by biting your tongue, and you alone carry what went unsaid.
angles.cost_self: Safe and unheard is where biting your tongue leaves you. You would rather bite your tongue than put your standing on the line for a point. You hand away the credit for everything you bit back, and a point never made cannot be yours.
angles.cost_others: You bite your tongue hardest around the people who need your answer. You keep things smooth instead of saying what you see, so you bite down while a bad plan passes. Biting your tongue costs them the one no they needed from you.

edge.lead: Water runs through your family, your social life and your career. It is the morning routine the whole home runs by, the promise your friends never have to check on, and the plan you make now for a year nobody can see yet.
